title: Corner welding machines
subtitle: GECAM 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-axis TIG and plasma corner welders for bent boxes — CWS 200 · CWS 300 · CWS 300 XY · WELCOR 400 X · XY · XYZ · XYZ-Φ
cover_line: GECAM · made in Italy · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_text: GECAM has designed and built machines for deburring, grinding and finishing metal at Vicofertile, Parma, since 1994 — 100 % made in Italy, with components from Italian suppliers within 125 miles of the plant, and CE-conforming to the Machinery, EMC and Low Voltage directives. Its corner welders weld the corners of bent boxes, cabinets, trays and enclosures with the torch driven by the machine: from the one-axis CWS for a straight corner seam to the four-axis WELCOR that reads the seam with a laser before it welds.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports GECAM corner welders in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario — copper groups and the welding power source chosen for your parts, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.

intro_pages.title: Which corner welder? Every model side by side
intro_pages.lead: The number of axes decides what kind of corner the machine welds in one cycle: one axis a straight seam, two and three axes a seam that runs in two or three directions, four axes adds torch rotation and a laser that reads the seam. Every model welds mild steel, stainless steel and aluminum with a TIG or plasma source at 0 – 47 in/min (0 – 20 mm/s), the part clamped pneumatically from inside against copper. Each section has its own pages further on, with the full specification table.

rows: Touch panel: X, Y positions, recipes
Large parts, torch driven on X and Y
Color touch screen, laser seam reading

paras: The corner is held square and kept cool by copper: on the CWS and the WELCOR 400 to three axes an outer unit 7-7/8″ or 11-13/16″ (200 or 300 mm) high and an inner unit of 1-15/16″, 2-15/16″, 3-15/16″, 4-15/16″, 5-7/8″, 7-7/8″ or 11-13/16″ (50 – 300 mm), cooled or not; on the four-axis WELCOR modular aluminum and copper pads 3/8″ to 7-7/8″ (10 – 200 mm) thick. Cooled inner groups are recommended to avoid dark marks on the parts.

Bend the corner so the two edges meet on it — .0004″ (0.01 mm) apart and centred on the corner — or, where the bend does not allow it, so they overlap by half the sheet thickness at most. On the CWS the gap between the edges must not exceed .008″ (0.2 mm).

Not included. GECAM offers the Lorch T 250 TIG source — T 250 DC for mild and stainless steel, T 250 AC/DC also for aluminum — with a cooling unit and a torch group with a 9′10″ (3 m) cable; the machines also work with a plasma source.
